sections.h2: What medical equipment service management software covers
paras: Medical equipment service management software is the system that takes a breakdown call from a hospital and carries it through dispatch, the technician's job card, the spares consumed, the SLA timer and the final invoice, then files every one of those steps against the serial number that was serviced. In Aura Business this runs across the Field Service and Ticketing suites, sharing one customer master and one installed-base register with sales, contracts and billing.

The value is in the loop rather than in any single step. A call that is logged but never dispatched, a job card that never reaches billing, or a spare fitted on site but never deducted from stock are the gaps a dealer quietly pays for every month. Here each stage hands off to the next, so nothing is typed twice and nothing is forgotten.

sections.h2: Five places a service call goes wrong between the phone and the invoice.
sections.lead: Most dealers already have engineers who fix things well. What they lack is a record of the fix that the office, the accountant and the hospital can all trust.

items.h: Calls logged in a chat group
items.p: A ward sister messages the sales rep, who forwards it to an engineer. Nobody owns the call, and nobody can say when it was raised.
The engineer cannot see whether the machine is under warranty, AMC or CMC, so the visit is either given away free or billed to an angry customer.
The carbon copy stays in the van, the spares list is incomplete, and the office invoices from memory a week later.
The hospital brings a list of slow responses to the renewal meeting and you have no counter-record.
The same ventilator has failed three times this year and nobody noticed, because each call was a fresh ticket with no asset behind it.

sections.h2: From the first call to a line in the asset history.

steps.p: The call is logged on the desk, from the customer portal, or by the rep on the app, against the asset.
The ticket shows warranty, AMC or CMC status and the SLA that applies.
An engineer is assigned by location, skill and schedule, and gets the job on the mobile app.
Fault, work done, readings, photos and spares are captured on site, offline if needed.
The customer signs on the phone and the job is marked done.
Covered jobs close to the contract; the rest become a GST service invoice with spares priced in.
The record sits on the serial number, ready for the next call, the audit and the renewal.

items.q: How is this different from field service software?
items.a: Field service is the engineer's side: dispatch, route, mobile job card. Service management is the whole loop around it, including intake, SLA, contract coverage, spares, invoicing and asset history. Aura Business includes both; see field service software for the mobile side.

items.q: Can hospitals raise their own service calls?
items.a: Yes. The customer self-service portal lets a hospital submit a ticket against its own equipment, and the ticket lands on your desk with the SLA timer already running. Calls can also be logged by your office or by a rep on the mobile app.

items.q: Does the engineer need internet on site?
items.a: No. The mobile job card works in offline mode, so photos, readings, spares and the customer signature are captured inside a basement or a rural hospital and sync when the phone reconnects.

items.q: How does it know whether a job should be billed?
items.a: Every asset in the installed-base register carries its warranty, AMC or CMC status. The ticket shows that coverage, so a covered job closes against the contract and an uncovered one becomes a GST service invoice with spares and labour.
Yes. Spares recorded on the job card are deducted from serial or unit-level stock, so the warehouse figure reflects what left in the engineer's bag. See spare parts inventory software.

Aura Business is delivered on a 30-working-day framework where scope allows. Your customer list, installed base and open contracts are imported from Excel, your branding goes on the app and service reports, and support is direct from the founder who built it.

items.p: Stock that moves with the job.
